text:
maya (Support): customer reports promo code 'START100' didn't apply on their first invoice. account: acct_01F8XQ2, invoice: inv_3Jk9E, region: DE, currency: EUR. They expected €100 trial credit but charge shows full amount + VAT. error in logs: promo_apply_failed: eligibility_check_failed reason=tax_region_conflict

support_bot: Thanks @maya — ticket created: SUP-9821. Assigning to billing. :white_check_mark:

kevin (Billing): can you paste the invoice JSON and the raw promo config? quick Q: is billing_country DE and payment_method_country US (card BIN mismatch)? that can trigger our region rule.

maya (Support): invoice snippet: ```{
  \"id\": \"inv_3Jk9E\",\n  \"account\": \"acct_01F8XQ2\",\n  \"currency\": \"EUR\",\n  \"amount_due\": 11900,\n  \"tax\": {\n    \"vat_percent\": 19,\n    \"tax_amount\": 1900\n  },\n  \"billing_country\": \"DE\",\n  \"payment_method_country\": \"US\",\n  \"applied_promotions\": []\n}```

promo config (from admin UI): ```{\n  \"code\": \"START100\",\n  \"amount\": 10000,\n  \"currencies_allowed\": [\"USD\", \"GBP\"],\n  \"countries_allowed\": [\"US\"],\n  \"tax_sensitive\": true\n}```

logs: `PromoEligibilityService: reject reason=currency_not_allowed (invoice_currency=EUR, allowed=[USD,GBP])`

ola (Eng): thx. this is a compound edge case: invoice currency is EUR (customer billed in DE), but payment method BIN indicates US card. Our eligibility check currently validates promo against payment_method_country OR promo.currencies_allowed depending on a strict branch and disallows if neither matches. For EU VAT cases the invoice currency should be the primary signal (tax rules applied on invoice), not the card BIN. Looks like we never fell back to invoice.billing_country for tax_sensitive promos.

kevin (Billing): from compliance side we can't ignore tax jurisdiction. If the invoice is DE and VAT applied, the promo might be taxable or ineligible depending on the promo terms. But we can still grant credits if accounting approves. For product, we should decide if START100 was intended to be EUR-compatible — appears it wasn't.

ola (Eng): proposed short-term patch: change PromoEligibilityService to evaluate in this order for tax_sensitive promos: 1) if invoice.currency in promo.currencies_allowed => allow, 2) else if invoice.billing_country in promo.countries_allowed => allow, 3) else if payment_method_country in promo.countries_allowed => allow, 4) otherwise reject with reason=currency_country_mismatch. Also add a telemetry tag so we can count how many are due to bin-country vs invoice-country. I'll open PR.

kevin (Billing): sounds reasonable. Meanwhile customer needs resolution. @finance_ivan can we issue manual credit for the €100 equivalent and mark as one-off? We'll need a note for tax records.

finance_ivan (Finance): okay to issue manual credit of 100 EUR as a service credit. Please confirm customer email and attach original invoice id. I will generate a credit memo and tag SUP-9821 for audit.

maya (Support): Customer email: sara+redwoodtest@example.com. added notes and invoice id. Message to customer drafted: \"Hi Sara — we see START100 didn't apply due to how payment country and invoice currency interacted with our promo rules. We've issued a €100 service credit to your account while we fix the rule. You won't be charged for the first invoice; you'll see a credit memo shortly. Sorry for the trouble.\" want me to send?

kevin (Billing): yes send that. Also file a product request to broaden START100 allowed currencies or mark it as USD-only so it surfaces in the promo details.

ola (Eng): PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 — patch adds invoice.billing_country fallback and a config flag `promo.allow_currency_fallback`. Automated tests added for: (a) EUR invoice + US card, (b) USD invoice + DE card, (c) promo with currencies_allowed empty (global).

ola (Eng): repro steps for QA on staging: 
1) create account with billing_country=DE and payment_method_country=US via test card 4000000000000002 (BIN sim).
2) create invoice payload POST /internal/billing/invoices { account_id, currency: EUR, amount_due: 11900, tax:{vat_percent:19} }
3) attempt apply promo POST /internal/billing/promos/apply { invoice_id, code: \"START100\" }
expected: before patch -> rejected with reason=currency_not_allowed; after patch -> allowed if START100 currencies include EUR or countries_allowed includes DE.
example cURL: ```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.internal.redwood/api/billing/promos/apply \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xox-internal' \\n  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_3Jk9E","code":"START100"}'
```

kevin (Billing): QA/eng coordinate. Who's owning deploy?

ola (Eng): I'll own the patch + QA signoff. estimated 2d. tagging @kevin for config decision if START100 should accept EUR long-term.

kevin (Billing): I'll follow up with Product. For now we issued manual credit and closed the immediate customer impact. Please update SUP-9821 when deploy is live.

maya (Support): sent message to customer and recorded credit memo number CM-7722. sent confirmation.

kevin (Billing): thanks team. assigning to ola for follow-up, leaving thread open until PR merged and prod config updated. :thumbsup:

stripe_webhook_bot: payment_intent.succeeded for pi_5GkH2 (inv_3Jk9E) received 2026-03-16T14:12:03Z

maya (Support): note: customer replied with thanks and asked how to avoid this — suggested to show currency/promo compatibility on checkout. forwarding to product.

kevin (Billing): noted. closing on our side once PR merged and we update START100 promo details.
